partner1.title: Automating real estate communication from phone to Telegram.
partner1.description: We built a custom Telegram bot that bridges the gap between Crypto-Immobilier's commercial and agent teams. Announcements shared through social media and phone are instantly relayed to available agents, who can update deal progress directly through the bot streamlining collaboration and response time.
partner1.subtitle: Real Estate Company

partner2.title: From new listings to instant social media updates.
partner2.description: For Next Cars, we developed a Telegram-based system that makes managing car listings effortless. Each new vehicle entry is sent to a database, and the bot automatically posts or updates it across social media keeping followers informed in real time and reducing manual work.
partner2.subtitle: Car Sales Company

about.intro1: We're <highlight>Vexa AI</highlight> a group of passionate <highlight>Computer Science</highlight> students who believe that <highlight>technology</highlight> isn't just for big companies.
about.intro2: We started Vexa with one clear goal: to help <highlight>businesses</highlight> of all sizes use AI to work smarter, faster, and better.
about.intro3: Born from late-night coding sessions and <highlight>big ideas</highlight>, our team brings together <highlight>creativity</highlight>, problem-solving, and a drive to make automation accessible to <highlight>everyone</highlight>.
about.mission1: To empower <highlight>businesses</highlight> through intelligent automation transforming <highlight>complex</highlight> manual tasks into seamless, efficient workflows powered by <highlight>AI</highlight>.
about.mission2: We want to prove that <highlight>innovation</highlight> doesn't need a massive budget, just vision and the right tools.
about.story1: Like many <highlight>startups</highlight>, Vexa AI began as a simple idea between friends in a <highlight>university</highlight> classroom.
about.story2: We noticed that many <highlight>businesses</highlight> were wasting time on repetitive, manual work that could easily be <highlight>automated</highlight>.
about.story3: So, we decided to use what we were learning coding, data, and AI to build real-world <highlight>solutions</highlight>.

services.ctaSubtext: We appreciate your interest in our AI automation solutions. Ready to see how we can help transform your business?

items.title: Education & Training
items.problem: Schools and training centers waste time on repetitive admin work like registrations, follow-ups, and tracking progress.
items.solution: We build smart automation systems that handle registrations, send reminders, track student data, and even manage communication automatically freeing educators to focus on teaching.

items.title: Hotels & Travel Agencies
items.problem: Staff spend hours managing bookings, confirmations, and guest communication manually.
items.solution: We create AI-powered booking and messaging systems that automate confirmations, check-ins, and post-stay reviews providing guests with a seamless 24/7 experience.

items.title: eCommerce & Online Stores
items.problem: Online sellers struggle with repetitive tasks like updating stock, responding to customers, and sending marketing emails.
items.solution: We design AI-driven automations that sync products across platforms, run smart email campaigns, and deploy chatbots that boost sales and customer satisfaction.

items.title: Real Estate Agencies
items.problem: Agents lose leads and waste time manually managing client follow-ups and property listings.
items.solution: We implement intelligent CRMs and AI chatbots that capture, qualify, and follow up with leads automatically turning prospects into clients faster.

items.title: Accounting Firms & Consultants
items.problem: Accountants spend too much time collecting invoices, tracking payments, and preparing repetitive financial reports.
items.solution: We build automation systems that gather client documents automatically, send payment reminders, and generate AI-powered financial summaries saving hours of manual work every week.

items.title: Healthcare & Clinics
items.problem: Clinics face heavy administrative loads with appointment scheduling, patient reminders, and data entry.
items.solution: We set up intelligent automation tools that handle appointment booking, send reminders, and securely organize patient records allowing staff to focus on patient care instead of paperwork.
